trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations throughout the continuous boundary; amplitude of peaks varies between 5 and 20 pixels relative to the local baseline curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the median notch to the outer distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Superimposed translucent circular artifacts (likely water spray or lens moisture) scattered across the lower-central region of the fluke.
